description:
Parser-feature parity: EMBER v2 (elastic/ember + LIEF 0.9.0) vs EMBER v3 (thrember + pefile) on the
SAME benign PE files.
corpus: DLL/PYD/EXE members (<= 8 MiB) of PyPI Windows wheels (win_amd64 + win32, cp312), open-source builds

extractors.v3: thrember features.py (EMBER2024) + pefile, translated by vitrine.ember3.to_v2

provenance.command: python scripts/parity_extractors.py compare --v2 v2.jsonl --v3 v3.jsonl --wheels-json corpus.wheels.json --corpus-note DLL/PYD/EXE members (<= 8 MiB) of PyPI Windows wheels (win_amd64 + win32, cp312), open-source builds
